authority: Actual registered verifier executions against frozen hashed inputs; this draft is not evidence.
input_manifest_required_entries: qualification claims, pass/block predicates and public provenance targets
unrelated fixture sources, contracts, carrier profiles, assignments and expected dispositions
negative control source/mutation recipes and exact expected rejection boundaries
ground replay implementation, strategy generator and selected recipe/rule bytes
normative VSCore 0.3 sources and model/profile descriptors
accepted contract and source/goal/correspondence module sources and parts
toolchain pin, required toolchain olean closure, dependency locks and environment identity
current policy, axiom allowlist, budgets, deadline and isolation settings
diagnostic retention format and finite bounds
declared TCB and permitted nondeterministic fields
verifier_registration_rule: Before qualification, bind a deterministic actual executable and implementation SHA-256 to each claim, with exact PASS/BLOCK/INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE exit-code mappings. Multiple proposed IDs may resolve to one shared verifier implementation only when all claim-specific predicates remain explicit and frozen. No LLM output or manual judgment discharges a claim.

required_evidence_envelope.bindings: Every raw result and referenced artifact has exact bytes/hash/size and a safe relative path. Evidence with another root, verifier hash or environment is stale and blocking.
required_evidence_envelope.immutability: Generated evidence is write-once. Repairs create a new candidate/root; never edit generated observations.

original_inputs: strict assignment wire and accepted binder sorts
proof_construction: strategy ID and exact recipe source/hash
compiler exit/status/sorry positions and bounded diagnostics
remaining shared budget at attempt start/end
normalization: normalized proof-state expression/hash if explicitly represented
transitive proof dependency audit excluding forbidden oracles
kernel_acceptance: Exact theorem name VeriSlopReviewProbe.result, original E or Not E type/hash, safe declaration, empty level parameters and no unresolved constants.
Independent complete staged-module kernel import/replay result with actual module part hashes.
One exact ground-result defeq check with ok, typechecks and defeq all true.
Supervisor-derived goal statement comparison and existing accepted theorem/transfer structural checks, without consuming transfer/guarantee proof as the observation oracle.
Exact reexported source AST equal to delivered canonical bytes.
Allowed toolchain import roots and bound actual toolchain olean closure.
No non-runtime safe/unsafe/partial replay omission beyond the unchanged existing rule.
Result theorem axiom inventory satisfying the unchanged axiom policy.
Result proof and normalization proof dependency closures with zero forbidden observation dependencies.
Normative library source identities unchanged after replay.
ground_observation_required_evidence.status_rule: Only after every required acceptance check passes: exact E gives predicate true and NOT_REPRODUCED; exact Not E gives predicate false and CONFIRMED. No other result yields an observed Boolean.
ground_observation_required_evidence.milestone_limit: These observations establish finite review results only; they do not assign TESTED or END_TO_END_VERIFIED or prove universal refinement.

compiler_diagnostics_design.purpose: Retain the evidence currently discarded when both polarity attempts fail, without falsely identifying a computational cause.
compiler_diagnostics_design.bound_status: PENDING. These are proposed caps on retained explanatory content, not increased process-output limits or a new authority. Freeze and qualify their precise encoder before implementation admission.
compiler_diagnostics_design.selection_rule: Retain the first bounded rows in original compiler order. Preserve original polarity and attempt identity. Normalize only declared machine-specific path prefixes for a separate deterministic comparison field; preserve the original bounded raw bytes/hash where the current process result makes them available.
compiler_diagnostics_design.truncation_rule: Mark every retention truncation explicitly. Record known original row/byte counts; use null when underlying process truncation makes the total unknown. A hash of already truncated process output must never be labeled a complete compiler-output hash.
compiler_diagnostics_design.failure_rule: Diagnostic formatting cannot change a probe's polarity/status. A required diagnostic capture failure blocks its qualification claim; inability to retain diagnostics must not fabricate a definitive observation.
compiler_diagnostics_design.public_wording: Use proof construction unresolved or the existing diagnostic. Attribute an individual cause only when actual bounded compiler evidence supports it.

declared_existing_components_to_bind: kernel replay/export and expression audit tooling
tcb_policy.candidate_generator: Untrusted proof proposer. Checked source-only readable rendering is not a new trusted evaluator.
tcb_policy.dependency_audit: Any new verifier code remains an explicitly identified existing orchestration/audit component; kernel observation authority cannot move to its host computation. A new trusted semantic/oracle component is disallowed. Required dependencies must be classified by current declared TCB categories before freezing.

two_clean_build_expectations.isolation: Fresh independent directories from the same frozen qualification input tree; no unrecorded cached goal/probe artifact reuse.
compare: proof theorem types and admitted proof dependency inventory
permitted_nondeterminism_to_freeze: temporary directory path prefixes in diagnostic display

final_report_expectations.tool_unavailable_or_registered_verifier_: INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE when it prevents completion independently of claim truth; preserve existing observed failures
final_report_expectations.scope_wording: VERIFIED means only the declared frozen finite qualification surface passed under the unchanged explicit TCB. It does not establish incident-task correctness or universal ground decidability.
